You own the requirements baseline and the interfaces that hold the mission system together, authored to standard, traceable end to end, and verifiable, so that what we specify to Canadian suppliers and build in-house maps back to the mission and forward to test. Run trade studies and manage budgets — SWaP-C, timing and latency, link and power — turning options into defensible decisions against mission need and threat. Drive verification and validation — define verification methods, build and maintain the verification matrix, and close the loop from requirement to demonstrated capability in simulation and on test platforms. Author vendor-facing specifications — SRDs suitable for Canadian suppliers — and technically evaluate what comes back.
